decisions.reason: Because it has only low public visibility and is not central to the announced direction, the escalation pressures are weaker, making discontinuation more plausible than for flagship products.
As a publicly presented flagship with its own product page, several models, and centrality to the firm's direction, high sunk costs and public commitment make withdrawal very unlikely.
Despite having its own product page, it lacks flagship status and centrality, so while persistence is likely, the probability of rationalization is moderate.
Close to the established offer with several models and its own page, substantial investment and public commitment reduce the likelihood of withdrawal, though less so than for flagships.
As a highly visible flagship central to the hydrogen-ready direction and launched with quantified public commitment, escalation strongly favors keeping it.
